en.quote: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
en.riddle: Let the day perish wherein I was born
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: יֹאבַד יוֹם אִוָּלֶד בּוֹ וְהַלַּיְלָה אָמַר הֹרָה גָֽבֶר
he.speaker: איוב

en.quote: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived. Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
en.riddle: Let the day perish wherein I was born
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: יֹאבַד יוֹם אִוָּלֶד בּוֹ וְהַלַּיְלָה אָמַר הֹרָה גָֽבֶר הַיּוֹם הַהוּא יְֽהִי חֹשֶׁךְ אַֽל־יִדְרְשֵׁהוּ אֱלוֹהַּ מִמָּעַל וְאַל־תּוֹפַע עָלָיו נְהָרָֽה

en.quote: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
en.riddle: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
en.speaker: Job

he.quote: לָמָּה לֹּא מֵרֶחֶם אָמוּת מִבֶּטֶן יָצָאתִי וְאֶגְוָֽע
